invite: Together with our families, we invite you to celebrate our wedding.

story.title: A borrowed umbrella
story.text: Monsoon, Jhamsikhel. One umbrella, two strangers, and a walk that took three times longer than it should have.

story.title: Poon Hill at sunrise
story.text: Our first trek together. Riya planned every stop; Aarav forgot the tea. We still argue about whose idea it was.

story.title: The question
story.text: Asked in Patan Durbar Square, under the window Riya had photographed a hundred times. She said yes before he finished.

story.title: The wedding
story.text: Four days of family, food and dancing in Kathmandu. We would love for you to be there.

events.name: Mehendi & Sangeet
events.dress: Bright colours, comfortable shoes for dancing
events.note: Henna artists from 4 PM. Music and dinner from 7 PM.

events.name: Haldi
events.dress: Yellow, and clothes you do not mind getting turmeric on
events.note: Close family and friends. Brunch is served after.

events.name: Janti & Bibaha
events.dress: Traditional: daura suruwal, sari, kurta or lehenga
events.note: The janti procession leaves at 10 AM. Ceremony and lunch follow.

events.name: Reception
events.note: Dinner, speeches and a very long dance floor.

faqs.a: We have held rooms in Thamel and Durbar Marg at a family rate. Message us and we will send the booking details.

faqs.q: How do I get to the venues?
faqs.a: Every venue is within 30 minutes of Thamel. On the wedding day a bus leaves Durbar Marg at 9:15 AM for the janti procession.

faqs.q: Can I bring a plus-one or children?
faqs.a: Your invitation lists everyone we have planned for. If you need to change that, tell us in your RSVP.
Your presence is the gift. If you would like to give something, a card on the day is more than enough.

faqs.q: Is there anything for guests flying in?
faqs.a: Nepal offers visa on arrival for most countries. Bring a passport photo and cash in USD for the fee.

faqs.q: Who do I call on the day?
faqs.a: Call Sagar (Aarav's cousin) on +977 98XXXXXXXX for directions, rides or anything else.
